correctness.rationale: The hub-anchored matrix is [qI+(q−1)A+(2−q)J]/2, with A the rim adjacency and J all ones. On the overall constants and between-rim mean-zero constants it has eigenvalues [2(n−1)−(n−3)q]/2 and (3q−2)/2 respectively. All remaining modes have eigenvalues [q+2(q−1)cos(2πj/ell)]/2. An even cycle first contributes one zero at q=2; otherwise the least eigenvalues are attained exactly on the longest odd rims and yield the stated local root. Positive cross-multiplication gives the comparison at n=cot²(π/(2L)); a tie would give the rational algebraic integer 2cos(π/L)=2(n−1)/(n+1), strictly between 1 and 2. Each first zero crosses with negative slope. The kernel and dimensions follow by the group and Fourier multiplicities and Gram rank, including unbounded even nullities by taking a fixed number h of equal sufficiently long odd rims, since cot²(π/(2L))/L→∞. The frozen notes report a bounded run (499 checks); its referenced script is not among the attached support. The independent `python /workspace/branches/independent_reproduction.py 2` passed 11 shortest-path/Gram cases, including mixed rims, multiple critical modes, and both sides of the seven-cycle/triangle switch. The analytic argument covers all permitted parameters, not the finite run.
